title: Beacon Ridge Residential Electricity Supply Sign-Up and Online Enrollment Credit Schedule
content:
Promotions bulletin, Residential Electricity Supply. The sign-up credit and the online enrollment credit are one-time bill credits attached to the plan a customer enrolls in. Their amounts, the number of completed billing cycles of continuous supply after which the sign-up credit is posted, and the forfeiture term are set per plan as follows.

| Plan | Sign-up credit (USD) | Completed cycles before posting | Unposted credit forfeited if the agreement leaves active status before qualifying | Online enrollment credit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | 0.00 | 0 | yes | 0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 | 0.00 | 0 | yes | 0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | 50.00 | 3 | yes | 25.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | 75.00 | 3 | yes | 25.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 | 50.00 | 3 | yes | 0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12 | 50.00 | 3 | yes | 25.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24 | 100.00 | 3 | yes | 25.00 |

A sign-up credit of 0.00 means the plan carries no sign-up credit. The online enrollment credit is an additional one-time credit for enrollments completed through the web channel, posted together with the sign-up credit.

**Points of reading.**

- Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable and Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 carry neither credit.
- Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 carries a sign-up credit of 50.00 USD but no online enrollment credit, so a web enrollment on that plan earns the sign-up credit only.
- On every plan that carries a sign-up credit, the qualifying point is 3 completed billing cycles.
